# Final Review: Arscontexta Vault Proposal

## Verdict: Strong foundation, 4 critical fixes needed before build

The proposal accurately captures our multi-platform reality and the 6 record types map well to our actual work. The main risks are **hook collisions** (our system already runs 45+ hooks) and **dual-write deduplication** between the vault and our existing PostgreSQL memory.

---

## CRITICAL Fixes (4) — Will cause real problems if missed
